CITY OF CAMBRIDGE
ORDINANCE NO. 2026-X1 (FICTIONAL TEST ORDINANCE)

AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE CAMBRIDGE MUNICIPAL CODE BY ADDING CHAPTER 8.99, RENTAL APPLICATION FEES

Section 1. Chapter 8.99 is added to read:

8.99.010 Application fees prohibited.
(a) No landlord of a residential building containing six or more dwelling units shall charge a prospective tenant any fee for a rental application, tenant screening or credit check.
(b) This section shall not apply to a building in which the owner occupies one of the units as the owner's principal residence.

8.99.020 Enforcement.
A landlord who violates section 8.99.010 shall refund the fee and is liable for a civil penalty of up to $300 per violation.

Section 2. This ordinance shall take effect on the first day of the sixth month next following its adoption.

ADOPTED by the City Council of the City of Cambridge on September 15, 2026.
